what: bug: every device should reach inference_domain through the bus, not by importing it directly
why: device_isolation ruling says only db_domain is exempt from cross-device import ban. librarian (and others) currently import inference_domain directly for embeddings. The bus is the sole path for inter-device comms — direct imports violate both the ruling and the bus design.
falsifier: grep -r from.cairn.devices.inference_domain across all devices other than inference_domain itself returns zero hits; every inference call routes through bus.request() or bus.post()
